name: get
title: http.get
lead: GET a URL. `cache` is the seconds a 200 answer is kept on disk; `timeout` is 1 to 60 seconds, 15 by default.
signature: http.get(url: string, options: {query: {[string]: string }?, headers: {[string]: string }?, timeout: number ?, cache: number ?}?) → HttpResponse

params.name: options
params.type: {query: {[ string ]: string }?, headers: {[ string ]: string }?, timeout: number ?, cache: number ?}

usedIn.quote: --                             it may wait (task.wait, http.get, stores); the chunk is done when it returns

- A `banner` is a 1024×512 PNG its creator uploaded and Minefort checked: 8 by 4 maps. Read it with `http.get(banner, { cache = 86400 }):image()`; a new banner has a new URL, so the cache never shows an old one.
`http.get` fetches a URL: map tiles, a leaderboard, any public API.
